findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 24 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 127 questions numbered 1-127; by section: 24.1 13, 24.2 14, 24.3.1 14, 24.3.2 7, 24.3.3 23, 24.4 6, 24.5 18, 24.6 9, 24.6.1 6, 24.6.2 8, 24.6.3 9. Covers every section 24.1-24.6.3 in order (classification of amines, preparation of primary, secondary and aromatic amines, basicity, nitrous acid test, reactions of phenylamine, diazonium salts, coupling and azo dyes, alkanenitriles and their hydrolysis, amides, amino acids, zwitter ion, electrophoresis, peptides). Small numericals (pKb from Kb, Kb ratios from Table 24.1, peptide links) were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: secondary amines carry –NH–, N,N-dimethylmethanamine, ethanamine pKb 3.29 (not 4.75), N-methylethanamide needs 2H₂ and gives water, phenylamine nitrogen sp² (planar), azo group N=N in methyl orange, loss of H⁺ in the coupling mechanism, charged zwitterion COO⁻/NH₃⁺; the disputed count of essential amino acids is not asked.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
